mechanism: Modafinil is a CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce bictegravir plasma concentrations, potentially compromising antiretroviral efficacy.
action: Monitor viral load and CD4 count closely; consider alternative wakefulness-promoting agent (such as armodafinil with caution or non-CYP3A4 inducers) or ensure bictegravir dosing adequacy with frequent clinical assessment.
